title: Round24 south foot-mask regression restored and eight-direction study started
summary: Actual Round23 frames had 7px or more bottom canvas clearance; the apparent clipping came from variable replacement boot masks intruding into the calf and cuff. Restored each full native Round22 ankle-to-sole assembly while preserving every non-leg Round23 pixel including hand and scarf repairs. Exported eight corrected south PNGs and independently decoded two-layer ASE. Eight static direction slots now contain four authentic cardinal references and four source-derived quarter-view construction studies with separate foot layers and static ASE; diagonals remain FAIL for torso/shoulder perspective and are not new walk cycles. Audited legacy cardinal silhouettes rather than assuming four displayed frames were unique. Full eight-direction animation, physical mechanics, editor-open and Android acceptance remain open. No engine changes or private art published.
